question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Should Linda and Kenji start dating?
Have you ever broken up with someone?
options: I'm working up the courage right now.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Hector, you and Howard grab the amplifier! Brendan, get the speakers! Dinah, clear some room in the party van!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: We're on it!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Linda, what about me?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Amanda, give us a cheer!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Rain, rain, in the sky, let us keep our stereo dry!
A few minutes later, the gang crams together inside the Party Van.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Wow! That was close! If you hadn't been so clear-headed, the audio equipment could've gotten soaked!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hooray!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Hector, you and Howard grab the speakers. No wait... You two are the strongest. You should grab the amplifier.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Okay... Are you sure?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Of course, I'm... No, wait... Maybe Brendan should...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: What should I do?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Uh... Well, you could maybe...
The sky opens up! Rain pours down!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Oh no! Everything is getting soaked!!!
A few minutes later, the gang crams together inside the Party Van.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Icky! I'm soggy like old cereal!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I guess it's possible that the stereo system wasn't ruined... But it's not very likely.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: We should just go home.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Well, for starters, this isn't just a day at the beach. Howard and I are coming up on our six month anniversary soon...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Oh! So that's what the 'surprise' is, a six month anniversay present!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Yeah, and I guess I just didn't want Howard to make such a big deal out of it.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Really?! I mean, six months is a long time to be dating! It's got to be getting pretty serious by now!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Why not celebrate being happy with someone you really care for?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: That is... Unless you're having second thoughts about Howard.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Because in that case, watching him make an elaborate and public gesture of affection would be torture.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Yeah...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Wow, Linda... What are you going to do?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I don't know! I really like Howard. I do! I've just never been in such a serious relationship. The last guy I dated only lasted two weeks!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I guess I'm just confused right now, and I need some time to think.
There is a blast of feedback as Howard turns on his microphone.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Everybody! Gather around! I'd like to make a special announcement!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Uh oh... Looks like that surprise you were dreading is about to happen!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You were all with us the night that Linda and I got together. Well, we've been together for six months now, and I wanted to do something special to celebrate the occasion!
Howard presses 'play' on his MP3 player. The first few bars of the classic eighties rock ballad, 'Girl, Will You Be My Lady', ring out.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Oh no! I think Howard is about to sing to me!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Cool! That sound system has some thunderous low end.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh... I don't think that 'thunder' sound is coming from the speaker.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Wait, you mean...?
Within seconds, grey clouds form overhead.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Look! Angel tears!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: That's called 'rain', sweetie! As in, it's about to!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Ack! There's stuff everywhere! What do we do?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Uh... Uh...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Uh oh... Looks like the guys are panicking!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Somebody is going to have to step in and take charge pronto, or all the stereo equipment is going to get soaked!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Yeah, I could tell.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You could? From all the way over there?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Linda, I spend a lot of time cultivating a look of 'soulful, heartbroken ennui', but you seem to have stumbled across the same look naturally... And that means something is very wrong.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I'm not really used to having close friends, so I'm not sure how this is supposed to work...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: But I'm pretty sure I need to talk to you about your feelings.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Thanks, Dinah. I really do need someone to talk to.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Of course! So tell me... What's the matter?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Really?! I mean, when I'm super excited, I sometimes isolate myself from other people and strike angsty poses in dramatic locales...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: But that doesn't seem like your thing.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Right! Exactly! I'm doing this because I'm just so... Very... Very... Happy...?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I came over here because you looked like you could use a friend. I didn't come here so you could lie to me!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: You want to be alone... Fine. I'll leave you alone!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: No, Dinah... Wait! I'm sorry. You were right. I really do need someone to talk to.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Okay... So what's the matter?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: And you're saying that by foiling a plot to assassinate Abraham Lincoln, the `Puce-ington Detective Agency` firmly established the role of private security in America?
nodes.text_bbcode: And you're saying that by foiling a plot to assassinate Abraham Lincoln, the [color=#3b78e2][i]Puce-ington Detective Agency[/i][/color] firmly established the role of private security in America?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Exactly! And the proud tradition lives on today! Now, if you're interested in a career as a security guard, I have dozens of informative brochures I could show you.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: See, this one is called 'To Taze or Not to Taze', and this one is called 'The Aluminum Flashlight... Your Best Friend'.
Linda notices Kenji has successfully hurdled the wall.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Great! I'll keep it in mind! Gotta go!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: But... But... What about these brochures?!
After sneaking in through the emergency exit, Linda and Kenji make their way down to the lower levels.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Wow! We're so close to the action!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Yeah! We did great!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: So you're saying you, like, guard stuff and stuff...?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Well, I like to think that there's a little more to it than that, young miss!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I certainly hope so. Otherwise, why not just get a dog?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: A dog?! A DOG?! Can a dog confiscate skateboards? Can a dog deliver a strong warning to a pesky loiterer?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Can a dog notice that guy trying to climb the wall over there and...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Wait a second! There's a guy trying to climb the wall over there!!!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Uh oh... `Kenji run!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh oh... [color=#3b78e2][i]Kenji run![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: And you, missy, you were trying to distract me, weren't you? I bet you two were trying to sneak into the track through the emergency exit!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Well, you're going to wish I was just a dog when you feel the high-voltage sting of my trusty `Thug Zapper!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, you're going to wish I was just a dog when you feel the high-voltage sting of my trusty [color=#e23b3b][i]Thug Zapper![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Yikes!
Kenji swings over the wall. He opens the emergency exit door and lets Linda slip inside.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Hurry! Come inside, and we'll try to lose Officer Monte in the crowd!
Linda darts through the emergency exit door. Kenji whips the door closed, slamming it in Officer Monte's face!
After a frantic pursuit, Linda and Kenji conceal themselves in the densest part of the crowd.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Well, these seats aren't very good, but at least we got inside.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Yeah, and I didn't get zapped by that lunatic Security Guard.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: We should totally check out the `Engine-X Races!` My favorite motorcycle rider, Jack 'Lubby' Stonard, is competing. Me and my old man talked about checking it out, but then... You know...
nodes.text_bbcode: We should totally check out the [color=#e23b3b][i]Engine-X Races![/i][/color] My favorite motorcycle rider, Jack 'Lubby' Stonard, is competing. Me and my old man talked about checking it out, but then... You know...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Anyway, what do you think? Want to go?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Well, I don't know too much about motorcycles...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: What's the matter? Scared to try something new?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: No, of course not!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: What I meant to say is... I don't know anything about motorcycles, which is why it sounds like the perfect thing to keep my mind off of my troubles. Let's do it!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Uh... Kenji, where's your car?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: My ride? It's right here.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: But that's a motorcycle!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Heck yeah it is! My uncle Hiroshi let me borrow it for the weekend! Isn't it awesome?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Yeah... I suppose...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Besides... what better way to travel to see the Engine-X races, right?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Okay... But you have to promise not to go too fast.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Fast?! Wait till you see 'Lubby' Stonard launch off a berm! Now that's fast! Compared to him, we'll just be cruising.
One motorcycle ride later, outside the track...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Bad news, Linda. The event just sold out. I guess these Engine-X races are more popular than I thought.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Okay... Not a problem. We'll find something else to do.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: No way! I've had enough disappointment already tonight! We're getting inside to see the race.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: But how...?! You said...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: That wall over there looks scalable. If I climbed over it, I could open the emergency exit door and let you in.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: But Kenji... That would be illegal. I know I wanted a distraction, but I'm not exactly comfortable with...
At that moment, Linda hears a familiar voice.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Move along! Nothing to see here!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Kenji, look! Officer Monte is providing security for the event.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I said, `MOVE ALONG`, you lousy punk kids!
nodes.text_bbcode: I said, [color=#e23b3b][i]MOVE ALONG[/i][/color], you lousy punk kids!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Go ahead! Give me an excuse to book you!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Okay, so Officer Monte is providing security. What does that have to do with anything?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: It means I still owe him for what he put Howard through at Boot Camp. Let's do this!
A few moments later...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Oh, Mister Officer, sir!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Yes, Miss? Are you in distress? Do you need assistance?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: No... I mean, yes! I mean, I saw you here, and you looked so strong and powerful...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: True... True...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: And I was hoping that you wouldn't mind if I asked you a few questions about your job.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Well, little miss, It just so happens that work is my second favorite thing to talk about... Right after the mating habits of the man-eating Siberian wolverine, that is.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Oh! Good... I think.
Linda spies Kenji preparing to climb over the wall.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Okay, time to do this! I'll need to ask good questions to keep Officer Monte from noticing Kenji!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I don't know, Linda. I'm not really feeling 'fun' right now.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Me neither, but we shouldn't let that stop us!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Uh... Why not?!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Well... You know how people always say 'Misery loves company'?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Yeah... So?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Well, I never bought into that. Misery may like company, but what misery `loves` is an awesome distraction!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, I never bought into that. Misery may like company, but what misery [color=#3b78e2][i]loves[/i][/color] is an awesome distraction!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Okay, but...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Come on! Do you really want to just sit here and feel sorry for yourself?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Yeah! Okay, I'm on board! And I think I have an idea about what we should do, too!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Sure! We can totally just sit here together and try not to talk about the things that are bumming us out.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: That sounds... Just great...
Linda and Kenji sit in awkward silence. Time passes. Tick... Tick... Tick...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Hey! Do you know what we need?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Therapy?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: What?! No! What we need is a distraction! Something that'll help us take our minds off of our problems.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Okay? Like what?
What is used

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: What?! I just heard a sound!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Mr. Sprinkles, is that you?
Mr. Sprinkles meows from the kitchen.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Sprinkles
nodes.text: Meow!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Uh oh... Guess not!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: But that means there's an intruder!
Linda charges into her room and finds...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: `Kenji!` What are you doing here?!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Kenji![/i][/color] What are you doing here?!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Relax, Pep Squad. I'm not here to rifle through your diary or anything.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I'm having some trouble at home, and I needed a place to chill until my Old Man calms down.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Oh... Okay, I guess... But why here? I mean, there are lots of other places you could go.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Yeah, maybe so... But I figured you still owed me one for helping out with the Float Caper. So is it cool if I hang for a bit?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Sure, I guess so...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Great!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Kenji, that thing with your dad, did you want to talk about it?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Nah. Talking isn't really my thing. Whenever I'm mad or angry, I just bottle it up inside.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: But what about you? You look like you had a pretty rough night yourself.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Yeah, I guess I did.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Do you want to talk about it? I mean, I'm cool with listening.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Thanks for asking, Kenji, but seeing as we're both a little down, I was thinking instead we could...
Find

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Great! I'm right on time!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Linda, hey! I'm glad you called! I know you were feeling upset earlier, but I promise you the party I'm planning will cheer you up!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Happy to help! I think... Wait. What were we talking about again?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You were explaining that breaking up is hard, but sometimes it's the right thing to do!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh... I did? Is someone breaking up? That's so sad!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Amanda!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Whoever it is, I hope they wait until later tonight. Otherwise, they'll ruin the big 'surprise' Howard is planning for you.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Everybody! Gather around! I'd like to make a special announcement!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Uh oh.
Howard, Brendan, Hector, and Spike take the stage. Spike has a harmonica, Brendan has a keyboard, Hector is on guitar... And Howard holds the microphone.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Many of you were here the night that Linda and I got together. Well, we've been together for six months now, and I wanted to do something big to celebrate! Linda, this one's for you!
Brendan starts playing the first few notes of 'Girl, Will You Be My Lady'! Hector and Spike join in!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Oh no! I'm starting to tear up! But if I start sobbing now, Howard will get the wrong impression. I need to stay strong!
Despite feeling a nearly overwhelming urge to cry, Linda keeps it together.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I can do this... I can do this...
Meanwhile, on stage...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: { I'll dance with you tonight... {

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: { And I'll be yours 'til I'm eighty... {

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: { I'm on my knees asking you now... {
Howard, Brendan, Hector, and Spike sing in unison.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: { Girl, will you be my laaaaaaaaady? {
The crowd bursts into thunderous applause!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Way to go!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: One more time!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Woooo!
Howard scans the crowd for Linda. He sees her wan smile, notices her trembling cheeks.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: That was amazing!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: We did it again!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Heck yeah!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Guys... Guys, you did great... But could you maybe watch the party for a little bit? I think Linda and I need to have a talk.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: { When I dance with you tonight... {

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: { And be yours 'til I'm eighty... {
As the music plays, Linda feels an overwhelming urge to cry... And she does!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I'm sorry! I tried not to cry! I... Sob... Sputter!!!
Linda dashes through the backyard and into the house.
Meanwhile, on stage... As the music stops, the crowd begins to jeer!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: What's the matter? Forget the words? Your band is terrible!!!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No, we're not terrible. We just...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: BOOOOOOOOO!!!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What?! Linda ran out on me during my big musical number! This is so humiliating!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Happy?! To break Zach's heart?! To give him a perma-frowny face for weeks and weeks?!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: No, I didn't mean it like that... I...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Then what did you mean?!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I guess I just wanted to know if you think you did the right thing.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Linda, it was hard... Maybe the most hardest thing I've ever done ever.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: But if I had it all to do over again, I would... Because Zach and I never made each other happy. We never connected. Not like Hector and I do. See?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yo! Check it! If I put one finger in my nose and another on my adam's apple, I can make a wicked trombone sound!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Tee hee! Silly!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Wow... Amanda, that was really thoughtful and well-reasoned of you. You really put things into perspective for me.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Of course, I was sad! I was soggy rainbows and spoiled milk and upside-down fishes inside for weeks and weeks!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Okay... So it was hard to break up with Zach?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: No, that was the easy part.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Seriously?! But you just said...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I know what I said, Linda... And I meant it. Breaking up with Zach was the easy part. The hard part was admitting to myself that I needed to do it. Did that help?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Yes! I mean, Wow... Amanda, that was really thoughtful and well-reasoned of you. You really put things into perspective for me.
That weekend, Linda stands in the backyard of Howard's house. For her, it is as if the entire world is moving in `fast forward...`
nodes.text_bbcode: That weekend, Linda stands in the backyard of Howard's house. For her, it is as if the entire world is moving in [b]fast forward...[/b]

nodes.text: Everything and everyone passes by in a crazy blur...
Zip... Zip... Zip...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Linda...? Linda...?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: `Linda!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Linda![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Uh... Did you say something, Amanda?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Don't take this the wrong way, but you seem pretty spacey tonight. Is something wrong?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: No, of course not... I...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey, Amanda! Come check out these killer tracks Brendan downloaded for me last night!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Just a minute, Hecky-poo!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hecky-poo?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Watch it, son. Nobody makes fun of my Amanda Bear!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Well, Linda, if you're sure nothing's wrong, I should really...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: No, wait! Amanda, I'd like to ask you a question. Something important. Something you can't tell Howard.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Uh... Okay, I guess.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: When you broke up with Zach, were you...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Wow! Who knew a motorcycle race could be so exhilarating? And I can't believe you let me steer your motorcycle on the ride home!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Yeah, you're a natural! You were practically racing like 'Lubby' Stonard!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Not exactly, but we did put it into third gear for a few seconds!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: So... I guess it pays to try something new, huh?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Definitely!
Kenji looks to Linda soulfully... Then averts his gaze.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Anyway, before you go, I just wanted to say thanks for not freaking out when I crashed your pad earlier.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: No problem, Kenji. I'm glad you did. I think we cheered each other up.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Yeah... Anyway, my old man has probably calmed down by now. What about you? Will you be okay?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Yeah, I... I think so...
A few minutes later, Linda enters her room. She picks up her cell phone. The 'new message' light flashes red.

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: You have 317 new messages.

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: Linda, this is Howard. I know you said we should slow things down, but this party is going to be really awesome! I know you'll love it!

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: BEEP!

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: Hey! It's me again! I know I already called, like, a hundred times, but that cafe you love agreed to cater the party, and...

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: BEEP!
Later that night, in front of Linda's home...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Uh... Mr. Stonard, sir... My friend, Kenji, is a huge fan of yours. I know he would love to get an autograph only, well... I don't have a program with me.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: If it wouldn't be too much to ask, could you sign my arm?

nodes.speaker: Lubby Stonard
nodes.text: Your arm...? Miss, if your friend really is a fan, he'll want to have something of his own to take with him...

nodes.speaker: Lubby Stonard
nodes.text: And I imagine you're pretty attached to that arm.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Right, well... I understand. If you don't want to...

nodes.speaker: Lubby Stonard
nodes.text: No, miss... What I'm saying is you should give him this ` motorcycle helmet.` Safety regulations say I have to swap it out after a crash anyway.
nodes.text_bbcode: No, miss... What I'm saying is you should give him this [color=#e23b3b][i] motorcycle helmet.[/i][/color] Safety regulations say I have to swap it out after a crash anyway.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You're giving me your helmet?! That's amazing!!!

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: Attention! Jack 'Lubby' Stonard please return to the pit!

nodes.speaker: Lubby Stonard
nodes.text: Well, that's my cue! Tell your friend to keep watching!
Lubby flashes Linda his trademark thumbs-up and heads off. A minute later, Kenji runs over.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Linda, hey! I've been looking for you. I got worried when you didn't come back to the seats. Were you just talking to Jack 'Lubby' Stonard?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Yeah! And I was going to get you an autograph... But I got this for you instead!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: You got me 'Lubby' Stonard's crash helmet?! That's killer!!!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Glad you like it. We should go find our seats. I want to see how 'Lubby' finishes the race now that his busted chain has been swapped out!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Mr. Stonard, sir... My friend, Kenji, is a huge fan of yours. I know he would love to get an autograph only, well... I don't have a program.

nodes.speaker: Lubby Stonard
nodes.text: Well, that's no problem. I'll just...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Right! Because I'm going to borrow one from a fan!

nodes.speaker: Lubby Stonard
nodes.text: No wait!!!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Excuse me, sir? Do you think I could borrow your program? I'll be sure to buy you a new one in just a...

nodes.speaker: Random Fan
nodes.text: Whoa! Is that 'Lubby' Stonard?!

nodes.speaker: Another Fan
nodes.text: It is!

nodes.speaker: Random Fan
nodes.text: We should show our appreciation for his motorcycling prowess by running at him like pack of deranged lunatics!

nodes.speaker: Lubby Stonard
nodes.text: Oh no! This... This is exactly what I didn't want to happen!
A few minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Linda, hey! I've been looking for you. I got worried when you didn't come back to the seats. And by the way, what was up with that mob that just ran by?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Oh, that... They were chasing down 'Lubby' Stonard.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: 'Lubby' Stonard was here?! Did you get his autograph?!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: No... I mean, I almost did, but... I messed it up.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Well... We should probably go find our seats. There are still a few more laps to go.
Linda searches left and right, looking for a phone... But all she can find is a grimy payphone covered in gum.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: This receiver is totally disgusting! I'm not even sure I want to put it near my ear!
Linda dials the number. After several attempts to push the sticky buttons, she finally inputs the correct sequence.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Linda, we were supposed to talk half an hour ago! What happened?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I'm sorry... I left my phone at home and I just... Nevermind. What did you want to talk about?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I just wanted to say... I know you were feeling upset earlier, but I promise you the party I'm planning will cheer you up!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What is he talking about? Did you do something illegal at the track? Linda?!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Howard, be quiet and stay down!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What?! Why?! Wait a minute... What's that whirring sound?! Is that a helicopter circling overhead?!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Linda, you and your accomplice were videotaped illegally entering a sporting event. A warrant has been issued for your arrest.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Surrender now, and we can make a deal! Try to run, and you will be prosecuted to the fullest extent of the law!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: What...?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Lying to me, going behind my back! Seriously, if you wanted to break up with me so bad, why not just go ahead and do it?!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Maybe I've been trying to! Maybe if you'd just shut up for half a second about this stupid six month anniversary, I would've been `able` to talk to you!
nodes.text_bbcode: Maybe I've been trying to! Maybe if you'd just shut up for half a second about this stupid six month anniversary, I would've been [color=#3b78e2][i]able[/i][/color] to talk to you!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh, so now you're putting this on me?!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Maybe I am!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah?!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Yeah!!!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh...  Not good!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: What?! That we're breaking up?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, but also... I just realized that I left this wireless mic on. I think everything we just said was broadcast over a loudspeaker to the entire party.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Everything...?!
Meanwhile, in the backyard...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Okay, well... I'll just go ahead and say it. That was pretty embarrassing for them. Maybe we should head out.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No guys, wait! We're sorry!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Guys?!
Ouch! Well, that break up was pretty painful... And pretty embarrassing to boot! Just because a couple needs to split up doesn't mean it needs to be so `public.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Ouch! Well, that break up was pretty painful... And pretty embarrassing to boot! Just because a couple needs to split up doesn't mean it needs to be so [b]public.[/b]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Linda? There you are! I've been looking everywhere for...
Great... But not quite `perfect.` Try again and see if you can unlock the special bonus scene!

nodes.text: A few minutes later, Howard finds Linda sitting alone in the bedroom, sobbing her eyes out.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: There you are, Linda! I've had it up to here with you!
Howard finds Linda sitting alone in the park across the street from the party.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Linda, there you are! Dinah said I might find you here, and...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No, I'm glad you found me, Howard. We've been needing to talk...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: About what? Was it the song? I know I went flat a few times, but I was really trying to remember all the words and...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Howard, the song was fine. Better than fine, even. It was amazing! I mean, just the fact that you threw this party for me... For us... It's incredible, but... But...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But what...?
Linda chokes up. She waits a long breathless moment and then speaks again.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: But as incredible as it was, it was also comfortable. And it may sound selfish, but I don't need comfortable right now. I need new and exciting and unpredictable!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But... I can be unpredictable! You'll see! Just tell me what to do, and I'll do it better than anyone!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Howard, that's just it. If I knew what I wanted...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Than we wouldn't be having this conversation, would we?
Linda shakes her head from side to side.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So this is it then? The end?
Linda nods.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Howard, I'm so... I'm so sorry...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, well... That doesn't make it hurt any less, does it? I should... I should really get back to the party.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Howard...?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You really are a great guy.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah... For all the good it did me.
Howard crosses away from the park, making his way back to the party. Linda is left alone. Tears stream down her cheeks.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Goodbye, Howard.
Whoa! That was pretty heavy stuff! But just like getting a cavity filled or ripping off a bandage, it was a painful thing that needed to happen.
It's just like they say... 'Breaking up is hard to do'! But even so, you navigated that treacherous terrain like an expert!
Or to put it more simply, you played a `great game!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Or to put it more simply, you played a [b]great game![/b]

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Look, maybe we should slow down. This party you're planning...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I know! It's going to be a total blast! Hector will be bringing his entire record collection, Kim will be bringing that red velvet cake I know you really like...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And I even ordered two dozen flower arrangements to decorate the backyard patio!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Flower arrangements...?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah! I picked white roses because I know that they're your favorite!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Howard, just... Maybe we should stop for a second, and...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: My only question is... Who should we invite? I know you prefer intimate gatherings, but practically the whole school was there when we got together, and maybe they'd like to come, too!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Howard! Can we please just stop for one second?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh... What?!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: We've only been going out for six months! We really don't have to make such a big deal out of it!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But... But... I thought...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Look... Let's just talk tomorrow, okay? Bye.
As Linda exits the office, she bumps into a tall gentleman wearing a cool motorcycle jacket.
As Linda ends the phone call, she notices a tall gentleman wearing a cool motorcycle jacket.

nodes.speaker: Lubby Stonard
nodes.text: Oh, excuse me, miss... Didn't see you there.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: No, it was my fault, I... Wait a second! I recognize you from the cover of the program! You're that famous Engine-X motorcycle racer, Jack 'Lubby' Stonard!

nodes.speaker: Lubby Stonard
nodes.text: Miss... Would you please talk more quietly? I don't mind speaking with one fan, but I'd prefer not to get mobbed.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Wait... Shouldn't you be racing right now?

nodes.speaker: Lubby Stonard
nodes.text: Turns out that I ripped a chain going over that last berm. But don't worry, my pit crew is fixing up my motorcycle as we speak. I'll be back on the track before you know it!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Kenji would go nuts if I could get him an autograph from Jack 'Lubby' Stonard... But I don't have anything for 'Lubby' to sign. I should...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Grr... Howard, I told you to be quiet!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: There... In that bedroom! Prepare to open fire on my mark! Ready... Set...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: No! Don't shoot! I surrender!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Hold your fire, men! It looks like she's coming out peacefully!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Thought you could outsmart me, did you? Well, I've got news for you... I always get my man. Always.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Even if, as in this case, the man I'm getting is actually a woman.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Please, Officer Monte, maybe we can cut a deal!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: A deal?! Ha! We don't cut deals with criminal masterminds. No, we cut deals with brain-dead lackeys like 'Clyde' over there.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Sorry, Linda.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Kenji, you sold me out?!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: It was you or me, babe. Someone had to talk first, or we'd both be staring at twenty-to-life in CenterScore Maximum Security Penitentiary.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Quit gabbing, and get in the back of that squad car, convict!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Linda, I'll wait for you! I promise! No matter how long it takes for you to get out of prison, I'll still be here waiting!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Be strong, my love! Be strong!

What?! Sure, Linda and Kenji did `bend` the law by sneaking into the Engine-X Races, but they didn't deserve that kind of ending! Somehow, you made choices so poor that the fabric of reality has begun to unspool.

nodes.text: Later that evening the rain has stopped, Howard drops Linda off outside her house.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm really sorry about today, Linda. I should've checked the weather forecast before I invited everyone out to the beach.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: No, it's okay, Howard. Really. At least now we'll have a chance to talk before...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No, it's not okay, Linda! We've been going out for six months now, and I want to do something special to celebrate!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: But Howard, it's...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You don't have to worry, Linda. I'll make it up to you! I promise!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: My parents are going out of town this weekend! That means I can throw a party! It'll be just like the time when Hector threw the Best Party Ever! Only better than that!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: That's... That's... Just great...
Half an hour later...

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: Heading into the sixth lap, Jack 'Lubby' Stonard takes the lead...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Heh. This is pretty sweet, right?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Linda? Is something wrong?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I just realized I left my cell phone at home.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: So?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: So I promised Howard I'd call him to discuss the party.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Whatever. Do it later.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Kenji, I'm not brushing Howard off like that. I'm going to see if I can find a phone nearby.
What is used

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: What?! I just heard a sound!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Mr. Sprinkles, is that you?
Mr. Sprinkles meows from the kitchen.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Sprinkles
nodes.text: Meow!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Uh oh... Guess not!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: But that means there's an intruder!
Linda charges into her room and finds...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: `Kenji!` What are you doing here?!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Kenji![/i][/color] What are you doing here?!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Relax, Pep Squad. I'm not here to rifle through your diary or anything.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I'm having some trouble at home, and I needed a place to chill until my Old Man calms down.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Oh... Okay, I guess... But why here? I mean, there are lots of other places you could go.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Yeah, maybe so... But I figured you still owed me one for helping out with the Float Caper. So is it cool if I hang for a bit?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Sure, I guess so...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Great!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Kenji, that thing with your dad, did you want to talk about it?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Nah. Talking isn't really my thing. Whenever I'm mad or angry, I just bottle it up inside.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: But what about you? You look like you had a pretty rough night yourself.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Yeah, I guess I did.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Do you want to talk about it? I mean, I'm cool with listening.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Thanks for asking, Kenji, but seeing as we're both a little down, I was thinking instead we could...
A few minutes later, Howard finds Linda sitting alone in the bedroom, sobbing her eyes out.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: There you are, Linda! I've had it up to here with you!

nodes.text: After several long months filled with action and adventure, Howard has invited the gang to the beach for a well-deserved break.
There are brand new couples...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And then Mallika was like, 'I said, 'chicken', not `'chicken'!`'
nodes.text_bbcode: And then Mallika was like, 'I said, 'chicken', not [color=#e23b3b][i]'chicken'![/i][/color]'

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Tee hee!
Almost couples...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Make sure you put on lots of sunscreen, Dinah. You'll want to stay nice and pale for the `Corpses Can Congo` concert next week.
nodes.text_bbcode: Make sure you put on lots of sunscreen, Dinah. You'll want to stay nice and pale for the [color=#e23b3b][i]Corpses Can Congo[/i][/color] concert next week.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Thanks, Brendan. But it's actually starting to look pretty overcast.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Howard, what are you doing with all that stereo equipment?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm just prepping for a little 'surprise'.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Oh... Well... Do you mind if I wait by the water? I have a bit of a headache, and... Howard? Are you even listening to me?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah... Whatever. Just stay close, okay? You're going to love this!
As Howard continues to tinker with the sound system, Linda crosses down to the shoreline and stares out at the water... Thinking.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Hey, Brendan... Linda looks a little down, don't you think?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh, I guess so. What do you think is wrong?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I don't know, but I'm going to talk to her and find out. Will you be okay hanging out with Hector and Amanda for a bit?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Sure, why would I not be...?
Brendan looks over to Hector and finds him feverishly making out with Amanda.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Smooch!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Tee hee!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh... Maybe I'll just go help Howard with his special 'surprise' instead.
A few moments later, Dinah joins Linda at the water's edge.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Linda, you look sad... Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Linda

The next day, Howard and his dad sit in a boat on Lake Centerscore...

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Now, son, I know sometimes a break up can make you feel like it's the end of the world.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, no kidding...

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: But that's why I've brought you fishing. I wanted to demonstrate by example that there are other fish in the sea.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But Dad... We haven't caught anything all day.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Of course not! The saying is 'There are other fish in the `sea!`'
nodes.text_bbcode: Of course not! The saying is 'There are other fish in the [color=#e23b3b][i]sea![/i][/color]'

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: This is a `freshwater lake` downstream from two sawmills, a cattle ranch, and a radium dial watch factory!
nodes.text_bbcode: This is a [color=#e23b3b][i]freshwater lake[/i][/color] downstream from two sawmills, a cattle ranch, and a radium dial watch factory!

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: The only things that grow in these waters are toxic slime molds and despair.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh... I think I'm starting to lose the metaphor here.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: No, son... What you 'lost' is Linda!

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: And the next time you get a girl that amazing, you clamp down hard, and you never let go. Not ever. You understand, son?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I... I think so. You're saying the sixth month anniversary I planned should've been even more elaborate.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: I'm proud of you, son. It took me years to figure that out.

nodes.text: What is he talking about? What sporting event? Linda?!
